subject: Pricing & commitment follow-up — post-call recap
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@tinytasks.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing & commitment follow-up — post-call recap

Hi Olivia — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

TL;DR
- TinyTasks use case: user-facing task generation + light classification for metadata. Expecting ~40-60M tokens/month during ramp; heavier burst windows during marketing campaigns.
- You're interested in the startup program + an option for a 12-month committed discount if it makes sense.

Recap / notes from call:
- Primary model: generative text (context windows ~1k tokens typical; some longer sessions up to 4k).
- Current prototype uses open models; production needs lower latency and predictable cost.
- Key asks: target $/1M tokens and whether we can offer a startup / committed-use discount to fit your $50-75k ARR budget for inference.

What we need to qualify discounts (can you send?):
1) Monthly token estimates (avg, 90th percentile, burst expectations)
2) Preferred billing cadence (monthly vs. annual prepaid)
3) Any compliance requirements (we briefly touched on SOC2)

Suggested next steps:
- If you can fill the token estimates in the attached pricing-model.xlsx, I’ll run a preliminary cost model and propose specific tiers.
- If you’re eligible for our startup program, we can discuss a startup discount (first 12 months) + an additional committed-use incentive for a 12-month prepay.
- I’ll loop Marissa on approval thresholds once we have concrete numbers.

Attachments: pricing-model.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Would you be able to send the token estimates by EOD Mon 3/2? If not, happy to do a quick 15-min follow-up to walk through the spreadsheet.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — High-performance inference for production LLMs

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@tinytasks.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & commitment follow-up — post-call recap

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. This is helpful. A few quick answers and a couple of asks from our side: 

Answers from our end:
- Ballpark tokens: we’re currently prototyping at ~30M tokens/month but expect to ramp to 40-60M within 2–3 months. During promo windows we could see short bursts up to 100M in a month.
- Billing: we prefer monthly billing but would consider annual prepay if the economics are materially better.
- Compliance: SOC2 is desirable but not a blocker for our first production.

Discount / pricing ask:
- We’re a seed-stage startup (pre-seed round closed last quarter). We qualify for startup programs and would love to see what Redwood can do for early-stage companies.
- Our budget target for inference is around $50–75k ARR. To be viable we’re targeting a unit cost in the ~$50–80 per 1M tokens range. Is that something we can get to with startup + committed discounts?

Next steps: I’ll populate your spreadsheet with the monthly estimate you asked for and send it back Monday. Also attaching our team deck so you have context on GTM and expected growth.

Attachments: TinyTasks-deck.pdf (presentation)

Appreciate you looping Marissa on approvals — happy to chat with whoever owns partner discounts if needed.

Best,
Olivia
Co-founder, TinyTasks
olivia@tinytasks.io

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@tinytasks.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & commitment follow-up — post-call recap

Thanks Olivia — that range and timeline makes sense. I reviewed the numbers you mentioned and ran a quick preliminary model. A few clarifying Qs so we can put a concrete offer forward: 

Clarifying questions:
- Can you confirm average session length (tokens in / tokens out) and percent of calls that will be long-context (>2k tokens)?
- Are embeddings used for retrieval (we price embeddings differently)? If so, approximate monthly embedding calls / tokens.
- Do you expect the distribution of traffic to be steady or concentrated in a few bursts per month (helps decide whether to recommend reserved capacity + burst provisioning).

Preliminary pricing note (for discussion only):
- List price estimate (baseline): ~$80–90 per 1M tokens for the model profile you described.
- Startup program: we typically offer 20–30% off list for qualifying seed-stage startups for the first 12 months.
- Committed-use (12-month prepay): additional 10%–15% depending on commit size and cadence.
- Combined, we could likely get to the $50–70 per 1M tokens range for a typical seed-stage commitment + startup credit — aligns with your target band.

I’m going to draft a mutual action plan: you fill the token estimates in the sheet and confirm whether you’d consider annual prepay; I’ll then route a 12-month startup + commit package to our pricing approvers.

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan):
1) Olivia: complete token estimates in pricing-model.xlsx by Mon 3/2.
2) Aditya: produce a detailed cost model and proposed discount tiers by Wed 3/4.
3) TinyTasks: confirm whether annual prepay or monthly billing preferred by Fri 3/6.
4) Redwood: finalize paperwork / SOW and discount approvals by Tue 3/10.

Attachment: TinyTasks-SOW-draft.pdf (SOW draft)

If you’re OK with that approach I’ll start the internal approval thread with pricing and discount ranges.

Thanks —
Aditya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pricing & commitment follow-up — TinyTasks (need pricing approval)

Marissa / Laura — forwarding the thread with TinyTasks. They’re seed-stage, projecting ~40–60M tokens/month and targeting ~$50–75k ARR for inference. Olivia wants to know if we can get into a ~$50–80 per 1M tokens band using startup + committed discounts.

My suggested approach:
- Offer startup program: 25% off list for first 12 months (seed-stage).
- Offer committed-use incentive: 10% additional off for a 12-month prepay at their expected run rate.
- Combined effective discount ~32.5% off list (compound), which would move a list rate of $85/1M to about $57/1M — inside their target.
- Include standard guardrails: minimum 3-months notice for ramp-downs, annualized commit documented in SOW.

I’d like approval to offer up to 30% combined discount (startup + commit) and to formally offer the SOW draft as attached. If we need to go deeper for strategic reasons (logo, referenceable case study) I can escalate for a one-time additional concession.

Quick ask: can you confirm approval (or cap) by EOD Tue so I can get back to Olivia with a firm number and draft SOW?

—
Aditya
